secret.description: Elsa Vogel hands a parcel of stolen goods to a man at the Kitchen at 7:30 PM.
Isidore Lefkowitz goes through the papers in the Victim's Suite from 6:30 PM while the victim is downstairs.
Concetta Alfano drinks alone in the Bar from 7:30 PM to 8:00 PM and will claim to have been anywhere else.
Booker Prentiss is with Patrick Sweeney in the Service Stairs from 11:00 PM to 11:30 PM, and both will say they were somewhere else.

people.name: Rutherford Stannard
people.role: a travelling salesman in patent medicines

secret.description: Rutherford Stannard is alone with Meyer Rosenbaum in the Roof Garden from 7:30 PM, and kills Meyer Rosenbaum at 7:30 PM.

coverSecret.description: Rutherford Stannard is not the person the register says. Nothing is hidden about the evening; the lie is in the paperwork.

people.name: Patrick Sweeney
people.relationshipToVictim: a childhood friend of the victim from the same block

Meyer Rosenbaum was found in the Roof Garden. The coroner puts death between 7:00 PM and 7:30 PM. One bullet below the sternum. Powder burns on the shirt front: fired close.
A nickel-plated revolver is missing from the Front Desk. The drawer it was kept in is open and the oiled cloth is still in it.
Rain began at 7:30 PM and did not let up. Anyone out on the street after that came back in wet.
The passenger elevator was out of order from 8:00 PM to 8:30 PM. Anyone changing floors in that time used the service stairs.
The service stairs were whitewashed that afternoon. There is whitewash on Patrick Sweeney's sleeve; Patrick Sweeney was on the stairs at 8:30 PM.
Eunice Dandridge says the bar radio carried a six-day bicycle race from the Velodrome at 11:00 PM, and that a rider fell at the bank and the lead changed hands. Anyone in the bar could tell you that.
Rutherford Stannard's papers do not hold up. Two signatures in the guest register, a month apart, are in different hands.
Found in the Front Desk: Three letters in Meyer Rosenbaum's hand to a woman Elsa Vogel is engaged to, kept in the drawer, the last one opened.
Vincenzo Vitale says Elsa Vogel told Meyer Rosenbaum to keep away, loud enough to turn heads.
Found in the Victim's Suite: A subpoena naming Meyer Rosenbaum as a witness before the grand jury, with Concetta Alfano's name written in the margin.
Vincenzo Vitale says Meyer Rosenbaum said to Concetta Alfano that a man who testifies sleeps better.
Found in the Front Desk: A draft codicil in Meyer Rosenbaum's hand striking Rutherford Stannard out of the will, dated last Tuesday and unsigned.
Vincenzo Vitale says Meyer Rosenbaum told Rutherford Stannard the lawyer was coming Thursday and that the arrangement would be changed.
